Composed raw app_batch envelope/request cancellation retains API admission until deferred upstream cancellation settles.
Final artifact currentness/authorization RPC stays before download Response; refusal releases admission and exposes no artifact bytes.
Busy responses occur before artifact failure reporting, context/Storage loads or model verification. Auth and membership refusal precede busy admission.

A full final page returns its last ID; one terminal empty page returns null. Two independent large records retain exact text/boolean/zero/null values and order.

Health/bootstrap/status/issuance/notifications remain outside the heavy projection gate.

limits: Actual-image API burst, network slow-consumer/disconnect, NGINX buffering and peak memory are independently owned native qualification gates. JavaScript stream tests are not OOM or hosted throughput proof.
